entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I want to go over the RPP's main p..."
entries.dialogueText: "I want to go over the RPP's main points to get a sense of your perspective."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I have no problem with that.""
entries.dialogueText: "I have no problem with that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree. The monarch should act as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. The monarch should act as the head of state, not the head of government."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Our country is still an absolute m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our country is still an absolute monarchy in all but name. Your father created the House of Delegates as a symbolic parliament, but the new constitution can give it the true authority it represents."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""After all, a constitutional monarc..."
entries.dialogueText: "After all, a constitutional monarch does not rule, Your Majesty -- they merely reign."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I disagree. Even with an empowered..."
entries.dialogueText: "I disagree. Even with an empowered parliament, the monarch should retain substantial powers over the government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You are not thinking radically eno..."
entries.dialogueText: "You are not thinking radically enough, Mr. Sazon. I don't believe the monarch should reign at all."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I know we had this conversation. B..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know we had this conversation. But I remain convinced that Rizian society will not accept such a drastic change. Maybe someday."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The constitution has to balance th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The constitution has to balance the power structure fairly so that no branch has complete authority over the other. That includes the Royal Family."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""That's what we've been working on.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's what we've been working on."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Firstly, the constitution will def..."
entries.dialogueText: "Firstly, the constitution will define the House of Delegates as the governing legislative body in Rizia, with clearly outlined procedures and jurisdiction."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Instead of the monarch, they will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Instead of the monarch, they will be in charge of managing the government budget and passing laws."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only if their decisions are subjec..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only if their decisions are subject to the monarch's -- to *my* -- approval."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only if the monarch holds the righ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Only if the monarch holds the right to veto their decisions."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Hm... We can propose that the mona..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hm... We can propose that the monarch can exercise the act of royal assent to approve of legislature. But a procedure must be defined so that the monarch cannot block every single piece of legislature at whim."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Hm... We can propose a veto proces..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hm... We can propose a veto process. But it must be defined in a way that doesn't allow the monarch to block every single piece of legislature at whim."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Our main objective is to ensure th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our main objective is to ensure the political participation of our citizens. This is only possible if the monarch's power is limited, as enshrined in the constitution."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We can discuss the exact details l..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can discuss the exact details later."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Secondly, we must decide whether t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Secondly, we must decide whether to keep the old regional structure in Rizia or centralize the system in Porte Drazon completely."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Keeping the provinces semi-autonom..."
entries.dialogueText: "Keeping the provinces semi-autonomous may embolden their leadership to go against the new government's laws. But the nobles in those provinces have held power for centuries. They will not easily accept centralization."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I'd rather not disturb the regiona..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd rather not disturb the regional system. We should respect the autonomy of the provinces and make sure each is represented fairly."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Rizia still resembles a feudal sta..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia still resembles a feudal state. We should find ways to abolish that."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In a system that already has sever..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a system that already has several branches of government and many actors, a decentralized structure will only bring instability. I support centralization."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I do have one concern there.""
entries.dialogueText: "I do have one concern there."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""A centralized government might run..."
entries.dialogueText: "A centralized government might run more efficiently, but citizens in those provinces may see it as a slight against ancient regional traditions."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""However, it raises questions regar..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, it raises questions regarding how the provinces should be structured in such a system."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The regions should have no autonom..."
entries.dialogueText: "The regions should have no autonomy or separate political structures. There must be equality among them, and laws must be implemented in a uniform way nationwide."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""While we should strive for each re..."
entries.dialogueText: "While we should strive for each region to be represented in the House of Delegates, the nation of Rizia must be ruled by its parliament alone."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It might be unpopular, but this is..."
entries.dialogueText: "It might be unpopular, but this is my vision for the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Each region should function as a s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Each region should function as a state, and be allowed to exercise autonomy within a constitutionally defined framework."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We should respect the historical,..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should respect the historical, financial and demographical differences of the regions. Especially when it comes to each province's governing House. We need their collaboration if we want to change the system."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I wouldn't change anything drastic..."
entries.dialogueText: "I wouldn't change anything drastic. Keeping the current decentralized system will only increase public participation."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""We can offer the nobility somethin..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can offer the nobility something, I'm sure."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I agree.""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I understand that, Your Majesty.""
entries.dialogueText: "I understand that, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He nodded."
entries.dialogueText: He nodded.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""If the regions retain a degree of..."
entries.dialogueText: "If the regions retain a degree of autonomy, their local governments will share power and responsibility with the central one."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""In a federal system such as this,..."
entries.dialogueText: "In a federal system such as this, having a second legislative body representing the provinces might be ideal. We could form an upper House."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""We need to give something to the n..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need to give something to the nobility for their support. We could have an upper House composed exclusively of nobles."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The legislative body should be uni..."
entries.dialogueText: "The legislative body should be unicameral. Complicating the system will only make it less efficient."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Abolishing the regional power stru..."
entries.dialogueText: "Abolishing the regional power structure would vest all powers in the hands of the central government. In a system such as this, I believe having a unicameral legislative body would be the best option."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree. Legislative responsibilit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. Legislative responsibility must be left to one single elected parliament."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Yes, we already have a parliament...."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we already have a parliament. It'll only make the system less efficient if we create a second one."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I flicked a switch hidden behind th..."
entries.dialogueText: I flicked a switch hidden behind the shelf of bottles. It rotated to reveal an opening in the wall, which led to a series of wooden staircases.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I knew the perfect place in the pal..."
entries.dialogueText: I knew the perfect place in the palace to have this conversation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I'd first learned about this place..."
entries.dialogueText: I'd first learned about this place from my father as a kid. He'd told me it was the only place in the palace where he could feel truly alone.

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Your Majesty, thank you once again..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Majesty, thank you once again for agreeing to this meeting. I cannot overemphasize how much I respect your decision."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""This will carve your name in the a..."
entries.dialogueText: "This will carve your name in the annals of history not as a monarch who clung to power, but as a visionary who saw beyond the crown."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The judiciary interprets, defends,..."
entries.dialogueText: "The judiciary interprets, defends, and applies the law in the name of the state -- and thus should be independent from other branches of government."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""To ensure that the executive and l..."
entries.dialogueText: "To ensure that the executive and legislative branches don't go beyond the powers enshrined to them, the judiciary must be given the right to put a stop to government actions that they deem unconstitutional."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree. Judicial independence ser..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. Judicial independence serves to safeguard the rights and privileges provided by the constitution. It should prevent the executive and legislative branches from encroaching upon those rights."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Fine by me. The amount of respect..."
entries.dialogueText: "Fine by me. The amount of respect that people have for the law is dependent upon the judiciary's status as a politically independent entity. Politicizing it will only hurt the rule of law."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The judiciary can't be too indepen..."
entries.dialogueText: "The judiciary can't be too independent. There must be mechanisms to prevent their abuse of power. Judges can't lack accountability."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""It *should* be, yes. But it is imp..."
entries.dialogueText: "It *should* be, yes. But it is impossible to design a system without any flaws. The judiciary is doomed to be politicized, and it is in the best interests of the country to ensure that those politics align with those of the ruling government."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Yes. The judiciary's role in decid..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. The judiciary's role in deciding the validity of the elections also necessitates their independence."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""I don't disagree. But the key is t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't disagree. But the key is to achieve equilibrium between accountability and independence to ensure that justice is upheld."

entries.title: Narrator: "He stopped for a moment to think an..."
entries.dialogueText: He stopped for a moment to think and went through his notes.

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""He and I agree that our main objec..."
entries.dialogueText: "He and I agree that our main objective is to ensure the political participation of our citizens. This is only possible if the monarch's power is limited, as enshrined in the constitution."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Our country is still an absolute m..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our country is still an absolute monarchy in all but name. Your father created the House of Delegates as a symbolic parliament, but the new constitution can give it the true authority it represents."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""This would mean the head of govern..."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""You will no longer rule, Your Maje..."
entries.dialogueText: "You will no longer rule, Your Majesty. But you'll reign, albeit in name only."

entries.dialogueText: "They will lead a cabinet of ministers, sit as a member of the House of Delegates, and determine the direction of the Rizian government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I don't object to any of this so f..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't object to any of this so far."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The head of government's powers wo..."
entries.dialogueText: "The head of government's powers would be clearly outlined in the constitution. The goal is to balance the power structure fairly so that no branch has complete authority over the other."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Very good.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very good."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I agree. The monarch should act as..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. The monarch should act as the head of state, not the head of government."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""That's what we've been working on.""
entries.dialogueText: "That's what we've been working on."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""With all due respect, Your Majesty..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, Your Majesty, I don't think you understand what Sotelato's movement wants."

entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""The House of Delegates itself will..."
entries.dialogueText: "The House of Delegates itself will be defined as the governing legislative body in Rizia, with clearly outlined procedures and jurisdiction."

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon
entries.title: Manus Sazon: ""Instead of the monarch, they will..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Only if their decisions are subjec..."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Manus Sazon

entries.dialogueText: "Unless you can accept the complete transfer of your sovereignty to the House of Delegates, the new constitution will never pass."
